subject: Trent Alexander-Arnold: from Ballon d'Or ambitions to the Real Madrid bench
title: Trent: from Ballon d'Or to the bench

lines.vo: He wanted the Ballon d'Or. Now he is watching from the bench.
Trent Alexander-Arnold has started five of sixteen Real Madrid games this season. A season-ticket holder, basically.
Under José Mourinho, he is behind Federico Valverde and Denzel Dumfries at right back. Third choice.
He has started eighteen of a possible fifty LaLiga games since joining. The bench knows him well.
He holds the Premier League record for assists by a defender, with sixty-four. Finding teammates is easy. Finding his name on the team sheet is harder.
Jamie Carragher says he would take him back to Liverpool. Talk only, so far.
His twenty twenty-four dream: first full back to win the Ballon d'Or. Ambition: ten out of ten. Starts: five out of sixteen.
